items.text: Dear Students,
The new update fixed more of the issues you reported around campus:
Fixed a bug that prevented Sam from putting items from his inventory into the locker when his inventory was full.
Fixed a bug that prevented Sam from picking up mission items when his inventory was full.
Fixed a bug that prevented Sam from collecting money when his inventory was full.
Fixed a bug that allowed you to scroll through your weapon inventory during minigames.
Fixed various collision issues.
Fixed an issue where the Bike Sign reward outfit didn't appear in the wardrobe for some players.
Fixed a bug that caused the Motion Blur setting not to save correctly.
Fixed Sam's animation getting stuck if a cop grabbed Sam shortly before the end of lesson time.
Fixed a camera clipping issue in town.
Other small fixes and improvements.
Thank you again all for your feedback and for helping us improve Agefield High as much as possible as a small indie team. We truly appreciate it!
The janitor is doing his best to keep the school running!
Your favorite faculty member,
Principal Carpenter
Dear Students,
The new update focuses on a number of issues you reported around campus:
Fixed a crash that could occur if a cop chased you into your house while a mission started inside.
Fixed a crash that could occur if a pedestrian chased you into your house while a mission started inside.
Fixed a crash that could occur if you rode a bike into your house while a mission started inside.
Fixed an issue that could cause some players to get stuck in cars if a cutscene ended on the street.
Fixed an issue where an NPC could continue attacking you if you entered a class during a fight, resulting in a black screen.
Made adjustments to prevent players from getting stuck behind doors in rare cases.
Other small fixes and improvements.
Thank you all for your feedback and for helping us improve Agefield High as much as possible as a small indie team. We truly appreciate it!
If you're still experiencing crashes, please let us know your PC specs and where they happen. The janitor is doing his best to keep the school running!
Your favorite faculty member,
Principal Carpenter
Dear Students,
The new update focuses on fixing crashes that affected players on lower-end devices. This includes startup issues, crashes at the tattoo shop on Steam Deck, and crashes during cutscenes.

Please note, students, every machine is different. If you are still experiencing crashes, please let us know where they happen and include your PC specs. We will continue investigating these issues and help where we can! The janitor has already checked the school computers twice, but unfortunately, hitting them with a wrench did not solve the problem.
If you're playing on a lower-end machine and still experiencing crashes, it may help to add the following command to your launch options:
Go to your Steam Library and right-click Agefield High: Rock the School
Click Properties...
Add -d3d11 to the Launch Options field
Thank you for all your feedback and for helping us improve Agefield High as much as we can as a small indie team. Much appreciated!
Your favorite faculty member,
Principal Carpenter
Dear Students,

Seems like those first day of school nerves got the best of all of us, and we forgot to make sure that the cafeteria was stocked with enough snack cakes and energy drinks for you all! We only have a few members of the faculty on hand, and we are doing our best to make the rest of this semester as smooth and fun for everyone as quickly as possible.

We had a sleepless night and prepared an update for you, making the music minigames easier to pass and fixing lots of smaller issues you mentioned. The janitor hasn't slept much either, so please be nice to him. I don't want to have to call anyone's parents over a disagreement in the hallway.

We appreciate all kinds of feedback, whether positive or negative. It can only help us make our school better. Of course, constructive criticism is always welcome. Anyone caught throwing chairs or painting angry messages on the walls will receive detention.

Thank you for attending Agefield High. After 2.5 years of development, it was my deepest honor to finally welcome you through its doors! If you haven’t entered the halls yet, please check out the Before You Attend post to get a feel for what this game is yourself and everything that we have put into this establishment.
Your favorite faculty member,
Principal Carpenter
